tickets.title: US001: Strict Allergen Filtering
tickets.description:
As a Student with food allergies, I want to filter the entire cafeteria menu by selecting specific allergens (e.g., "No Peanuts"), so that I can safely browse and order without anxiety.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. Pass/Fail: When an allergen filter is applied, items containing that allergen are completely removed from the UI, not just greyed out or disabled.
2. Pass/Fail: Multiple allergen filters can be applied simultaneously.
